# Hop

Sunset 0.1.0. Archive. GET /v1/meta returns version 0.1.0 and status sunset.

Point an agent at this file (or /openapi.yaml, /SKILL.md, /documentation/README.md, /documentation/judge.md). It can pay Hedera exact x402 and call POST /v1/query in seconds. No SDK. No API key. No login.

Verifiable decision infrastructure for agents. Paid HTTP 402. Fixed query types. Explicit protocol keys. Demo: lending policy gate.

Why in the workflow: the tool call before the tool call that cannot be undone. Map ask → POST /v1/query → 402 → pay exact x402 → ALLOW|HOLD|DENY|REVIEW → then the real tool. Attach /verify/{id}. Not on every token — on spend, bind, or actuate. Enterprise: uninsured process without a receipt. Why lock: documentation/language.md.

## Spec

- Protocol language (commercial source of truth): documentation/language.md
- Architecture and integrations: documentation/README.md
- OpenAPI: openapi/openapi.yaml
- Agent skill: skills/hop-query/SKILL.md
- Human docs: /docs
- Judge pack: /docs/judge
- Swagger: /swagger.html
- Discovery: GET /.well-known/agent-card.json
- DID: GET /.well-known/did.json
- OAuth advert: GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource (query is x402, not OAuth)

## Routes

- POST /v1/query — Hedera exact x402 (Blocky402). Idempotency-Key required on paid retry. Optional X-Hop-Mandate, X-Hop-Confirm, X-Hop-World, X-Hop-Passport, X-Hop-Did, X-Hop-Erc8004. 200 includes receipt hop.decision.v1 (verdict ALLOW|HOLD|DENY, reason_code, screening, verify_path, optional identity.did / identity.erc8004). stale/k_anon_denied are charged attempts.
- GET /v1/evidence/{id}/verify — hashes, Mirror Node settlement, tiers, hop.decision.v1 receipt
- GET /verify/{id} — public verify page (copyable)
- GET /v1/identity/passports — issue/list/bind/revoke Hop passports
- GET /v1/mandate — remaining budget (does not pay)
- GET /v1/meta — rails, protocols, meter, mandate remaining, HCS, CRE, World ID, identity, hitl, standards
- 503 cre_unavailable | graph_unconfigured | policy_unavailable — before payment.
- GET /v1/evidence/{id} — public hashes. No Account.id. No policy caps.
- GET /v1/evidence/{id}/peac — PEAC-shaped receipt
- GET /v1/assets/config — official ATS v8 factory/resolver
- POST /v1/assets/intents — requires accepted + Mirror-verified settlement
- GET /v1/liquidation — official Sepolia ChallengeLending status
- GET /v1/world — World ID readiness
- POST /v1/world/rp-context — RP signature
- POST /v1/world/verify — World ID 4.0 Cloud verify → hop token

MCP: hop_meta, hop_mandate, hop_pay, hop_query, hop_evidence, hop_peac, hop_verify, hop_passport_issue, hop_passport_get, hop_passport_bind, hop_passport_revoke, hop_world_rp_context, hop_world_verify (`npm start -w @hop/mcp`).

## Settlement

- network: hedera:testnet
- asset: "0.0.0" (HBAR tinybars) or HTS token id
- extra.feePayer: facilitator GET /supported — must match
- Client: @x402/hedera ExactHederaScheme
- Not Graph Base USDC x402
- Amount = base + extra per additional protocol (+ optional public-util term). Never the secret cap.

## Query types

market_params | position_counts | liquidations | policy_check | account_ltv

Data: Messari Lending/CDP 3.1.0 on configured Gateway subgraphs (Aave v3, Compound v3). Same operations on every protocol. Evidence records subgraphId, schemaVersion, methodologyVersion, block, blockTimestamp.
